name: clinic-management-css-build
description: CSS minification build tooling for Clinic Management System - cz-css-1004 remediation. Minifies all unminified CSS/SCSS/LESS source assets via PostCSS/cssnano in the Docker multi-stage build pipeline, reducing ECR storage costs and Kubernetes pod startup time. CURRENT FIX BATCH (cz-css-1004): 30 occurrences in font-awesome.css (lines 876-965) covering icon glyph content declarations (.fa-hospital-o:before through .fa-frown-o:before) - all resolved by PostCSS/cssnano minification pass in Docker Stage 1 (css-minify). Specific occurrences: Line 876 (.fa-hospital-o:before content: \f0f8), Line 879 (.fa-ambulance:before content: \f0f9), Line 882 (.fa-medkit:before content: \f0fa), Line 885 (.fa-fighter-jet:before content: \f0fb), Line 888 (.fa-beer:before content: \f0fc), Line 891 (.fa-h-square:before content: \f0fd), Line 894 (.fa-plus-square:before content: \f0fe), Line 897 (.fa-angle-double-left:before content: \f100), Line 900 (.fa-angle-double-right:before content: \f101), Line 903 (.fa-angle-double-up:before content: \f102), Line 906 (.fa-angle-double-down:before content: \f103), Line 909 (.fa-angle-left:before content: \f104), Line 912 (.fa-angle-right:before content: \f105), Line 915 (.fa-angle-up:before content: \f106), Line 918 (.fa-angle-down:before content: \f107), Line 921 (.fa-desktop:before content: \f108), Line 924 (.fa-laptop:before content: \f109), Line 927 (.fa-tablet:before content: \f10a), Line 931 (.fa-mobile-phone:before/.fa-mobile:before content: \f10b), Line 934 (.fa-circle-o:before content: \f10c), Line 937 (.fa-quote-left:before content: \f10d), Line 940 (.fa-quote-right:before content: \f10e), Line 943 (.fa-spinner:before content: \f110), Line 946 (.fa-circle:before content: \f111), Line 950 (.fa-mail-reply:before/.fa-reply:before content: \f112), Line 953 (.fa-github-alt:before content: \f113), Line 956 (.fa-folder-o:before content: \f114), Line 959 (.fa-folder-open-o:before content: \f115), Line 962 (.fa-smile-o:before content: \f118), Line 965 (.fa-frown-o:before content: \f119). Includes: style.css, font-awesome.css, bootstrap.css, form-elements.css, grid-view.css, patient-style.css, footer-distributed-with-address-and-phones.css, demo.css, font-awesome LESS files (animated, bordered-pulled, core, fixed-width, larger, list, mixins, path, rotated-flipped, stacked), and font-awesome SCSS files (_animated, _bordered-pulled, _core, _fixed-width, _larger, _list, _mixins, _path, _rotated-flipped, _stacked).
